description: This file implements the Netlink class for Linux netlink socket communication, including functions for opening/closing sockets, sending/receiving messages, and parsing netlink responses related to network interfaces, addresses, routes, and rules.

classes.name: LinkInfoParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to network link information, specifically interface name, index, type, hardware address, and broadcast address.

classes.name: LocalAddressParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages to extract local IP addresses and interface addresses, filtering by interface index and flags.

classes.name: UnknownParser
classes.description: Handles generic netlink messages, primarily for logging purposes.

classes.name: RoutingRuleParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to routing rules, extracting scope, table, destination subnet, preferred source, and output interface.

classes.name: IpRuleParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to IP rules, extracting source address range and table.

methods.name: Netlink::OpenSocket
methods.description: Initializes a netlink socket and binds it to the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::CloseSocket
methods.description: Closes the netlink socket and resets buffers.

methods.name: Netlink::ResetRecvBuf
methods.description: Resizes the receive buffer for incoming netlink messages.

methods.name: Netlink::GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves network link information for a specified interface.

methods.name: Netlink::GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: Netlink::ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Adds or deletes a local IP address on a network interface.

methods.name: Netlink::GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Retrieves routing rules from the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces a routing rule in the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::GetRuleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves IP rules from the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds, removes, or attempts to replace an IP rule.

methods.name: Netlink::Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::Recv
methods.description: Receives netlink messages from the kernel, parsing and dispatching them.
